$comment: Issue-routing registry for the tool repositories Hatsu maintains or reads, verified from their origins and GitHub on 2026-09-12 (zheref/hatsu, zheref/nen), 2026-09-28 (zheref/bankai-handbooks) and 2026-10-19 (zheref/akatsuki-ai, PRIVATE: its code stays private and its name is public by the maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-19, docs/PUBLIC-REDACTION.md section Named private repositories -- the one private repository this public registry may carry). This does not assert consumer adoption or Hatsu's own release pins. `pinned` on the zheref/bankai-handbooks entry is the tag of THAT repository at which Hatsu's resolvers read canon (hatsu:bankai-handbooks, hatsu:bankai-quality) -- prose nen carries but does not model on a maintained_tools entry; move it when the canon is repinned, tag first (CON-13). `pinnedSha` beside it is the commit that tag resolved to at the repin, recorded by hand until nen canon pin --write records and reads it back (zheref/nen#506); a tag that later resolves elsewhere is a moved tag, never a newer canon.

maintained_tools.role: Canonical handbooks, constitution and shared agent conventions (CON-13) -- the canon Hatsu resolves live and mirrors into consumers
Akatsuki, the autonomous CI plane -- its constitution, agent workflows and the Ninjutsu CI CLI; canon (ruled 2026-09-19) and private, named by the ruling of 2026-10-19
